messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000843": As of 2025-12-05, Diego Alvarez leaves Team Cinder and joins the Ember team.  (about: Team Cinder, Diego, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000835": As of 2025-12-01, the resizer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from the Ember team.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000813": As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000805": As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000790": On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook.  (about: Marcus, Farah, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000780" [constraint]: There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000683" [decision]: As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger.  (about: ledger, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000680": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, billing service)
- memory_id "1000675" [constraint]: Do not upgrade the ledger service past Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000562": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder reported that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000522": The Ember team never owned the webhooks service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000468": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team flagged that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000442": The Ember team holds its planning meeting every Friday.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000436" [decision]: On 2025-06-13, the Ember team decided the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000367" [constraint]: The billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000352" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000349": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000345": During INC-2025-011, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000338" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000213": The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000208": The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings.  (about: ledger, billing service)
- memory_id "1000189" [constraint]: The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
Existing entity names: Team Cinder, Diego, Ember team, Team Dune, resizer, reporting service, Team Atlas, ledger, Marcus, Farah, billing service, event bus, Postgres 14, webhooks service, scheduler, INC-2025-011, auth gateway, reports pipeline
